name: hackaton-ecosistema
description: Ecosistema Multi-Agente para Ventas y Gestion Conversacional - Hackathon FISEI UTA 2026

scripts.dev: npm --workspace=@hackaton/shared run build && npm --workspace=@hackaton/web run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm --workspace=@hackaton/shared run build && npm --workspace=@hackaton/web run dev
scripts.dev:bot: npm --workspace=@hackaton/shared run build && npm --workspace=@hackaton/bot run dev
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@hackaton/shared run build && npm --workspace=@hackaton/bot run build && npm --workspace=@hackaton/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@hackaton/shared run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces
